definition: Artificial Intelligence for Environment & Sustainability (ARIES) is an international non-profit research project hosted by the Basque Centre for Climate Change (BC3) headquartered in Bilbao, Spain.
details: It was created to integrate scientific computational models for environmental sustainability assessment and policy-making, through ecoinformatics.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. That is Artificial Intelligence for Environment & Sustainability — a small key that opens a big door.
